# AdPad

> A peer-to-peer marketplace for unconventional and guerrilla ad placements. Creators list a space (event booths, worn merch, X posts, street spots); sponsors book it and pay in USDC, held in an OpenApps escrow on Solana until the creator's public proof is checked.

## Pages worth reading

- [Home: browse listings](https://adpad.fyi/): live listings by creators, with price, format and past sponsored work.
- [How payment works](https://adpad.fyi/how-it-works): where the USDC sits at every step: booking, creator accepts, escrow lock, proof, check, challenge window, payout.

## How a deal works

1. A sponsor books a listing with a brief and an amount.
2. The creator accepts or declines the booking.
3. The sponsor locks the USDC in escrow from their own wallet.
4. The creator does the work and submits a public proof link.
5. The AdPad agent compares the proof with the brief and approves a release or a refund. A disputed escrow is decided by the treasury owner, not the agent.
